decisions.value: Build a new backend framework with its own programming model and runtime semantics.
AI agents across capability levels are the primary authors and operators.
No existing backend framework may own or implement the core service model or runtime.

evidence: E-001 parser and canonical IR prototype
Equivalent structured IR fixture
Go and Rust domain-service baselines
decisions.reason: No agent-authored task study, hidden acceptance evaluation, or repeated agent-cost measurements have been completed.

evidence: E-002 shared HTTP conformance passes for Go, Rust, WASI P2, and BEAM
Initial three-repetition CI smoke matrix
Second three-repetition smoke matrix using pinned toolchains and committed Cargo.lock files
Four-candidate black-box conformance now rejects ambiguous raw query encodings and parameter ordering consistently across Go, Rust, WASI P2, and BEAM
Benchmark runner rejects runs with non-200 responses, unexpected bodies, transport failures, or candidate exit during load
decisions.reason: Both shared GitHub-hosted CI smoke matrices are explicitly not decision-grade; representative persistence, serialization, authorization, inter-service, cancellation, and fault-injection workloads plus controlled dedicated-machine measurements remain outstanding.

decisions.value: The E-003 reference model is provisional and does not yet define production semantics.
evidence: Bounded admission and concurrency tests
Deadlines, cancellation, retries, worker crash, idempotency, and shutdown tests
Strict validation of task/worker identities, concurrency limits, deadlines, retry counts, outcomes, and results
Running cancellation and deadline expiry retain worker/outstanding capacity until explicit worker finish/crash acknowledgement
decisions.reason: Production cancellation transport, bounded worker kill escalation, durable persistence, distributed atomicity, fairness, leases, clock skew, multi-process fault injection, and production runtime enforcement remain unresolved.

decisions.value: The E-004 reference model is a provisional policy contract; no production authorization, sandbox, or secret-management architecture is selected.
evidence: Default-deny principal/tenant/capability model
Effect allowlist and resource-scope checks
Expiry and strict delegation attenuation tests
Threat model and machine-readable requirements
Canonical resource path checks reject percent-encoded paths, backslashes, control characters, dot segments, and non-NFC Unicode
Delegation compares normalized scopes so trailing-slash equivalence cannot masquerade as attenuation
Typed trusted time, grant expiry/depth, and immutable effect allowlist validation
decisions.reason: Cryptographic grants, revocation, workload identity, storage isolation, sandbox enforcement, network egress, secrets, resource quotas, human approval integration, and production authorization integration remain unimplemented.

decisions.value: The E-005 progressive-disclosure tool surface is a reference prototype; no transport or protocol is selected.
evidence: Compact tool catalog
Immutable content-addressed proposals
Read-only validation and planning
Apply disabled by default
Automated safety-oriented interface tests
decisions.reason: Constrained/general/advanced agent trials, token and tool-call measurements, authenticated approval, and trusted mutation semantics remain outstanding.

decisions.value: E-006 SQLite implementation is a single-node semantic reference only; no production persistence or queue substrate is selected.
evidence: Durable idempotent submission
Lease expiry with monotonic fencing tokens
Crash rollback across local state/effect ledger/task completion
Concurrent claim and process-reopen tests
Strict type and finite-JSON validation for durable task, lease, retry, and local-effect inputs
SQLite write-transaction race test proves cancellation fencing and local effect/task completion have one serialized winner
decisions.reason: External side-effect delivery, multi-node coordination, authenticated worker identity, production cancellation transport, retention, schema evolution, recovery operations, and representative workload measurements remain outstanding.

decisions.value: E-007 defines public task statements and trace metrics only; acceptance oracles must remain outside the agent-visible workspace.
evidence: Ten machine-readable task definitions
Provider-neutral trace schema
Metrics aggregation tests for tokens, tools, repairs, interventions, cost, wall time, and acceptance
Trace aggregator validates retry and failure metadata types and rejects unknown fields and non-finite telemetry
decisions.reason: Isolated evaluator workspaces, external oracle packaging, provider telemetry adapters, pinned agent cohorts, and repeated trials remain outstanding.

decisions.value: The E-008 reference model demonstrates producer outbox atomicity, fenced at-least-once relay delivery, and consumer inbox deduplication. Arbitrary external side effects are not exactly-once.
evidence: Producer state and outbox insert rollback together at injected crash points
Relay lease fencing rejects stale ack/retry
Publish-before-ack crash causes redelivery while consumer inbox applies local state once
Semantic envelope binds payload, state key, and amount
Finite retry budget and terminal failure state are tested
decisions.reason: No real broker, separate producer/consumer databases, multi-node failure model, external API idempotency adapter, distributed observability, or production recovery policy is implemented.

decisions.value: Pre-register a one-service-replica capacity acceptance hypothesis of 1 vCPU, 1 GiB service memory, 100 completed control-plane requests/second at concurrency 32, p99 <= 100 ms, sustained CPU <= 50% of one vCPU, and <= 25 cgroup CPU-seconds per 5,000 completed requests. Compare Rust/Tokio+Hyper with Go/net/http only after identical product-workload semantics and all hard gates pass. No runtime is selected by this decision.
constraints: Inference and external provider calls are outside the measured runtime path
Use the authenticated Agent/tool-execution control-plane request mix
Use 10 randomized repetitions per candidate with 5,000 measured requests and 250 warm-up requests per repetition
Use controlled one-vCPU host and cgroup v2 accounting for capacity claims
All functional, security, data-integrity and registered failure assertions are hard gates
No score or selection when required evidence is missing
Select only with at least 5 weighted-score points advantage, paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval excluding zero, and no rank reversal under +/-20% weight sensitivity

selection_rule.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap 95% interval for score difference must exclude zero
selection_rule.weight_sensitivity: vary each weight by +/-20%, renormalize to 100; ordering must not reverse
selection_rule.if_both_pass: select higher score only when margin, confidence interval, and sensitivity requirements all pass; otherwise no winner
selection_rule.if_evidence_missing: no selection; missing evidence is not measured, never zero
